The kids painted the cat. You earned $60 and a story. 🎨🐈
You hung out with friends instead. 🙌

events.text: 💬 Your crush texted you 'hey'.

outcomes.text: You talked until 2am. You're dating {partner} now! 💞
They meant to text someone else. 😭
They thought you weren't interested. Oops. 🫠

events.text: 📞 A recruiter calls with a job offer: a 30% raise to switch companies!

outcomes.text: New job, new office, bigger paycheck! 💼📈
Your boss heard about it and gave you a 10% raise to stay! 🙌
Your boss didn't even notice. 😑

events.text: 💌 {friend} is getting married and wants you in the wedding!

outcomes.text: You gave a speech that made everyone cry. 🥂
{friend} was really hurt. 💔

events.text: 🚗💨 Your car broke down on the highway.

outcomes.text: The tow and the repair cost a small fortune. Ouch. 🛻
You fixed it with tape and hope! It works! 🔧
You made it worse. Tow truck AND a bigger bill. 🔧💸

events.text: ⚖️ You've been called for jury duty!

outcomes.text: You helped decide a big case. You feel very responsible. ⚖️

choices.label: Try to get out of it

outcomes.text: You said you were 'too biased against pigeons'. It worked. 🐦

events.text: 🔊 Your new neighbor plays drums at 3am every night.

outcomes.text: They apologized and you became friends with {friend}! 🥁
They played louder. 🥁😤
A noise war began. Nobody slept for a month. 🎺🥁
Peace and quiet. Finally. 😴

events.text: 💡 A friend wants you to invest in their startup: an app for pets to text each other.

outcomes.text: The app EXPLODED! Your share is now worth $100,000! 🚀🐶
The company went bust. Dogs can't type. 💸
Smart move... probably. 🤷

events.text: 👛 You found a wallet with $500 in it on the bus.

outcomes.text: The owner was so grateful they gave you $100! 💛
You kept the $500. You feel... not great. 😶

events.text: 📈 Your boss offers you a promotion... but you'd have to move to another city.

outcomes.text: New city, new title, more money! 🏙️📈
You stayed close to family and friends. That's worth a lot. 🏡

events.text: 🔥 There was a small fire in your kitchen!

outcomes.text: You put it out like a hero! 🧯🦸
The firefighters were quick. The repairs were not cheap. 🚒

events.text: 🤢 That gas station sushi was a mistake.

outcomes.text: The doctor gave you medicine. You'll live. 💊
Worst 2 days of your life. 🚽😵

events.text: 📜 A lawyer says a great-aunt you never met left you something in her will!

outcomes.text: She left you a pile of money! 💰👵
She left you... 40 porcelain cats. 🐈🐈🐈

events.text: 🧾 The tax office wants to audit you!

outcomes.text: Everything was in order. Phew. 🧾
You found a mistake... in YOUR favor! Refund! 💰
You owed a big fine. Oops. 🧾💸

events.text: 🔥 You've been working nonstop and you feel exhausted.

outcomes.text: A week away and you feel human again. 🏖️
You pushed through... and burned out. 😵‍💫
You pushed through and got a huge bonus! 💰
Talking helped a lot. You set some boundaries. 💛

events.text: 💒 You ran into your high school sweetheart at a wedding.

outcomes.text: You laughed for hours. You're dating again! 💞
It was nice, but you've both changed. ☕
You hid behind the cake table for an hour. 🎂

events.text: 🏃 {friend} wants you to run a marathon with them!

outcomes.text: You crossed the finish line together! 🏅
You made it to mile 18 and got a ride on a golf cart. 🛺
You made a sign that said 'run like you stole something'. 🪧

events.text: 🐾 Your {petkind} {pet} ate something weird and needs the vet.

outcomes.text: {pet} is fine! The vet bill was huge, though. 🩺{petemoji}
{pet} threw up a sock and is totally fine. 🧦
{pet} got sicker and needed the vet anyway. Bigger bill. 💸

events.text: 💻 There's a 24-hour hackathon this weekend with a $10k prize!

outcomes.text: Your app won FIRST PLACE! $10,000! 💻🏆
You coded for 24 hours and your app crashed during the demo. 💻💥
You slept 12 hours. Also a win. 😴

events.text: 📺 A dating reality show wants you as a contestant!

outcomes.text: You found love on the show with {partner}! 💘📺
You got voted off first. On national TV. 📺😬
You watched it from home and judged everyone. 🍿

events.text: 🎟️ Everyone at work is chipping in $20 for a lottery pool.

outcomes.text: YOUR OFFICE WON! Your share: $250,000! 🎟️🎉
You lost $20 and gained 4 lottery buddies. 🎟️
You saved $20. (They didn't win. You checked.) 😌

events.text: 🏡 You find your dream house... and it's on sale!

outcomes.text: They accepted! The house is yours! 🏡🔑
Someone outbid you by $1,000. 😭
You saved the listing to your favorites. Someday. 🏡💭

events.text: 👑 At a party, you meet a real prince! He seems to like you...

outcomes.text: You're dating ROYALTY! You married into the royal family! 👑💍
He said you were 'very nice' and walked away. Royal rejection. 👑😔
He said yes! Your selfie with a prince got 2 million likes. 🤳👑

events.text: 🗡️ The Queen's office wrote to you: you're being knighted for your good deeds!

outcomes.text: Arise, Sir/Dame {first}! 🗡️👑
You declined. Very humble. People respect you even more. 😇

events.text: 📦 You dug up a time capsule you buried as a kid.

outcomes.text: A drawing of a dragon, a pog and a letter to future you. You cried a little. 🥹

events.text: 💳 Someone stole your identity and bought a jet ski with your card!

outcomes.text: The bank caught it and gave you your money back. Phew! 💳
You lost thousands. And you don't even get the jet ski. 🌊💸

events.text: 💃 Your dance video is going viral!

outcomes.text: The sequel blew up even more! 🚀
The sequel flopped. One-hit wonder. 💃📉
You deleted it, but the internet never forgets. 😳

events.text: 🎉 Your coworkers threw you a surprise party!

outcomes.text: You gave a heartfelt speech. Everyone cried, including the boss. 🥲
You did the worm on the conference table. Legend. 🕺

events.text: 👵 Your grandkids are visiting for the weekend!

outcomes.text: Flour everywhere, cookies everywhere. Perfect. 🍪

choices.label: Tell them stories about the old days

outcomes.text: You told them about phones with cords. They didn't believe you. 📞
They went home on a sugar high. Their parents are furious. 🍬😈

events.text: 📱 Your grandkid set up a new phone for you.

outcomes.text: You sent your first emoji! 👍 It was a thumbs up. You use it for everything now.

choices.label: Go back to your old flip phone

outcomes.text: Your flip phone has worked since 2005. Why change? 📟

events.text: 📝 You wrote a bucket list. What's first?

outcomes.text: You jumped out of a plane at {age}! The instructor screamed more than you. 🪂
Your doctor said absolutely not. 🩺
Your painting of a sunset sold at a local fair! 🎨
You called an old friend you'd fallen out with. You both cried. 💛

events.text: 💘 Someone at the community center keeps saving you a seat at bingo.

outcomes.text: You're dating again at {age}! Love has no age limit. 💞
They just liked your seat. 😅
You have a new bingo buddy, {friend}! 🎱

events.text: 🦴 Your hip has been hurting a lot lately.

outcomes.text: New hip! You're dancing again! 💃🦴
Your cane is fancy and has a duck head on it. Stylish. 🦆

events.text: 📜 Your family keeps asking about your will.

outcomes.text: Everyone gets an equal share. Very fair. 📜⚖️
Your {petkind} is now a millionaire. {petemoji}💰
You booked a world cruise. YOLO! 🛳️
